title: JUKI DDL-8700B-7
subtitle: High-Speed 1-Needle Lockstitch Machine with B-7 Control

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI DDL-8700B-7 is a high-speed 1-needle lockstitch sewing machine with the B-7 multi-function control package. It is a general-purpose industrial sewing machine for medium-weight fabrics and is widely deployed on apparel production lines for straight-stitch seaming operations.
applications: General straight-stitch seaming on shirts, blouses, trousers, and light workwear
Production lines requiring automatic reverse-feed stitching and bobbin counters
Apparel operations benefiting from a multi-function operator panel (B-7)
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (woven), shirt production, trouser production, light industrial textile assembly

overviewDescription: The JUKI DDL-8700B-7 is a high-speed 1-needle lockstitch machine from the DDL-8700 series, paired with the B-7 control set. It uses a DB×1 needle system, full-rotary hook with automatic lubrication, and a compact servomotor (e.g. M92, 400 W rated / 550 W max output). The B-7 feature set adds a multi-function panel, automatic reverse-feed stitching, a thread clamp option, and a bobbin counter. The machine is lubricated automatically with JUKI Machine Oil 7 (ISO VG7).

finalNotes:
• The B-7 control set is the distinguishing feature of this variant — it adds electronic panel functions not present on the base DDL-8700 model.
• The 'H' suffix in DDL-8700B-7H would indicate a heavy-weight variant (DB×1 #19–#23) for thicker fabrics such as denim and workwear.
